name: Heo Jeonghyeon
source:
Popular dancer. She is honest and cool, but she has a warm heart for those she truly cares about. She is a choreographer of various idols and the winner of a dance competition TV show. She decided to join the show to promote her newly opened dance academy.

[From in-app]
